Game Overview

At its heart, Clay Craft Tycoon is a tycoon game about quick, browser-based gameplay.

How to Play

Getting started in Clay Craft Tycoon doesn't take long to learn. Jump in, follow the on-screen goal, and aim to beat your own best result each run.

Related FAQs

What is Clay Craft Tycoon?

Clay Craft Tycoon is a free tycoon game you can play instantly in your browser, with no download required.

Is Clay Craft Tycoon free to play?

Yes, Clay Craft Tycoon is completely free to play in your browser on GameBurst — no download or installation needed.
